result.topic_en: Calculations on a quartic curve formed from the square of a ternary quadratic form plus xyz(x+y+z), finding its intersections with the lines x=0, y=0, z=0, x+y+z=0, followed by the definition of a three-variable theta function with its period scheme and a half-period shift of the summation index.
